data.long_meaning: Ashena is a name derived from the Arabic language, which means 'noble, pure, delicate'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in the Islamic faith. The name Ashena carries the meaning “Noble, Pure, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashena usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, pure, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
